body.statement: For every deterministic sequence \(a_n\to0\) with \(\sqrt n a_n\to\infty\), the total common-Gaussian rectangle satisfies \[\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{P_n\in\mathcal M}P_n\{\Phi(p_n)\in C_n\}\ge1-\alpha.\] The full-plane branch covers identically when \(B_n=\varnothing\) or \(M(\widehat p_n)=0\), and the infimum includes legal arrays with arbitrarily vanishing covariate cells, survivor cells, active-cut gaps, and endpoint variances.
body.justification: Uniform joint coverage is the headline result and cannot be replaced by endpoint-wise Bonferroni or pointwise bootstrap validity.
body.gap: Frandsen and Pond start from asymptotically normal bound estimators, whereas the two imported sharp endpoints here undergo changing nonlinear directional limits and may have jointly vanishing scale.
body.consumer: Clinical and labor applications using survivor-complier ordinal outcomes obtain one honest confidence statement for the entire sharp benefit interval.

obligation.what_is_open: Complete the uniform coverage proof by supplying the unresolved legal relative-comparison premise.
obligation.obstruction: The theorem's only nonroutine probability bound is exactly \(\texttt{oeq:legal-relative-comparison}\), which remains unproved. Treating that OEQ as established would be circular, and neither endpoint-wise Bonferroni nor an absolute directional delta method controls the stated vanishing-scale arrays.
obligation.attempted: I proved the deterministic inner-neighborhood inclusion on the high-probability event \(\|\widehat p_n-p_n\|_\infty\le a_n/2\), the resulting conditional-quantile ordering, and the uniformly negligible fallback probability. This reduces coverage exactly to the unresolved OEQ and no further.
obligation.partial_result: Let \(A_n=\{\|\widehat p_n-p_n\|_\infty\le a_n/2\}\).  Uniformly, \(P_n(A_n^c)\le2|\mathcal J|e^{-na_n^2/2}=o(1)\).  On \(A_n\), \(\mathcal B(p_n,a_n/2)\subset B_n\), so \(T_n(g)\ge E_{p_n,a_n/2}(g)\) for every \(g\), and therefore \(c_n\ge Q_{1-\alpha}\{E_{p_n,a_n/2}(G^*)\mid\widehat p_n\}\).  Hence the theorem follows immediately from a positive resolution of \(\texttt{oeq:legal-relative-comparison}\), together with the already proved uniformly negligible fallback event.  The only unproved premise is that OEQ's relative comparison.
